title: Validate tokens in the handler and send LinkAccount cards for signed-in intents
description: JWT validation against the pool JWKS (cached), with a mapping to the Papyrus user and groups. Signed-in intents without a valid token reply with a LinkAccount card and fall back to public content. Gherkin: linked, unlinked, expired and revoked, against a fake JWKS.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done: Cognito access token verification and the LinkAccount helpers, in AnthusAI/Papyrus#941.
